scope_verbatim: The AUTOMOTIVE SERVICING (ELECTRICAL REPAIR) NC II Qualification consists of competencies that a person must achieve to service manual air- conditioner system, diagnose and repair manual air- conditioner system, repair manual air-conditioner compressor magnetic clutch, diagnose and repair ignition system, diagnose and repair starting system, diagnose and repair charging system and diagnose and repair body electrical system.
